name: Remotion CSS Mask Text Reveal
use_when: A text highlight, split-color fill, glow reveal, or soft wipe should be generated in Remotion.
The text needs responsive layout, exact duplicate-layer alignment, and soft alpha control.
A CSS gradient, raster mask, or SVG mask can express the reveal cleanly.
avoid_when: A hard rectangular reveal with no softness can be handled with simpler clip-path.
The text is dense accessibility captions that should remain stable.
The mask mode or duplicate layer alignment cannot be tested.
The final compositor is already FFmpeg and the text is pre-rendered.

timeline_pattern.pattern: base_text -> duplicate_styled_text -> css_mask_or_svg_mask -> optional_masked_glow_duplicate -> local_frame_progress -> transparent_export_or_final_composite
timeline_pattern.alpha_rule: Use alpha masks when opacity should control visibility; use luminance masks only when grayscale brightness should drive opacity.
timeline_pattern.layer_rule: Base text, styled duplicate, and glow duplicate must share font metrics and positioning.

motion.rule: Animate mask position, size, or gradient stops from off-word to off-word using local frame progress.

keyframe_values.short_form_reveal: Use 6-15 frames for fast highlight wipes when readability holds.
keyframe_values.title_reveal: Use 12-24 frames for calmer title/lower-third reveals.
keyframe_values.soft_edge: Keep gradient feather narrow enough to read as a reveal edge rather than blurry text.

sound.rule: Use no sound or one trimmed shimmer/tick only when the reveal has a real beat job.

captions.rule: Suppress or reposition ordinary captions if the masked text carries the spoken words or occupies the caption region.

color.rule: Both base and masked states must preserve contrast; test alpha and luminance modes before changing colors.

implementation.ffmpeg: If exporting from Remotion, composite the transparent overlay later; if rebuilding in FFmpeg, use a grayscale mask plus alphamerge instead of CSS.
implementation.remotion: Use CSS mask-image, mask-size, mask-position, SVG masks, or clip-path; drive progress with interpolate/useCurrentFrame and render transparent ProRes/PNG sequence when needed.
implementation.blender: Use compositor masks or material alpha to reveal duplicate text objects with soft edges.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Duplicate text, compound the styled layer, and keyframe Split/Film Strip masks with feather for equivalent reveals.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Duplicate text graphics, apply Linear Wipe/track matte/mask to the styled layer, and keep the base text stable underneath.

common_mistakes: Using clip-path when a soft opacity gradient is required.
Using luminance mode accidentally and getting reversed or unexpected visibility.
Letting duplicate text drift by one pixel during the reveal.
Masking the solid text and glow together when the glow needs separate edge control.
Using the effect on important captions without a stable accessible text layer.
qc: Mask mode is explicitly chosen when alpha/luminance behavior matters.
Base and duplicate text layers align at start, midpoint, and hold frames.
Mask starts and ends outside the word with no slivers.
Glow/highlight does not appear before the letters it reveals.
Text remains readable over bright, dark, and busy backgrounds.
